title: Staggered launch runway + traffic arbitration for runtime/console/api
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: define and deliver a staged launch runway and traffic arbitration mechanism that coordinates runtime, Console, and public API releases to avoid simultaneous capacity spikes and to provide deterministic rollback gates. Scope: planning matrix for staggered windows, a traffic arbitration policy (priority lanes + emergency preemption), stakeholder runbook, and verification playbook (shadowing, smoke, and load tests). Deliverables: 1) Launch runway Gantt and slot allocator template; 2) Traffic arbitration policy document and machine-readable config; 3) Cross-team cutover checklist and communications template; 4) Rehearsal test plan and success criteria. Success metrics: no more than 1% increase in 99th percentile latency during cutovers, zero customer-facing errors attributed to release collisions, and deployment completion within the allocated window in 90% of rehearsals.
